item.title: Strong Junior Node.js Developer (NestJS)
item.description:
We’re looking for a skilled Backend Developer with strong experience in NestJS and PostgreSQL who is eager to learn and grow with us. You’ll be developing and maintaining high-quality backend applications using modern Node.js technologies and scalable architecture approaches. This is a great opportunity to work on exciting projects, collaborate with a friendly team, and take your career to the next level. Come join us and let’s build great things together!

🧰 Requirements:

  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Strong hands-on experience with NestJS.
  • Experience with TypeORM.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Good understanding of RESTful API design principles.
  • Experience with unit testing (Jest or similar).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda) will be a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Pre-Intermediate English level or higher.

🧰 As a plus:

  • Experience with Docker.
  • Experience with Redis, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch.
  • Understanding of microservice architecture.

💻 Responsibilities:

  • Developing and maintaining high-quality backend applications using NestJS and related technologies.
  • Designing and implementing scalable RESTful APIs.
  • Working with PostgreSQL databases and optimizing queries.
  • Implementing and maintaining data models using TypeORM.
  • Following high coding standards and best backend development practices.
  • Troubleshooting and debugging applications to ensure optimal performance.
  • Participating in code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver tasks on time.
  • Keeping up-to-date with industry trends and backend development best practices.

🎁 We offer:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on challenging and innovative projects.

item.title: Full-Stack Backend Developer — Hosting, Tracking & Payments
item.description:
Fully remote · Start hourly → convert to full-time

 

About us

We build and scale health & wellness digital subscription / web products (info products, assessments, companion-style apps). Product + growth move fast: a lot of early surfaces are vibe-coded, then need to become real production systems next to media buying and analytics.

 

About the role

Backend-leaning full-stack engineer who can take vibe-coded funnels and products (e.g. Base44-style builds, GitHub exports, AI-generated apps) off the sandbox and onto self-hosted infrastructure — then wire pixels, GTM, GA4, Amplitude, and payment APIs so ads and subscriptions actually track and charge correctly.

You do not need quiz-funnel DNA. That’s a plus, not a requirement. You do need to read PSP/docs carefully and ship reliably.

 

What you’ll do

  • Export / migrate vibe-coded projects (GitHub / similar) into clean repos and self-hosted environments
  • Own hosting, deploys, env/secrets, basic ops for funnel + product surfaces
  • Connect Meta / Google (and related) pixels; implement GTM + GA4 events correctly (purchase, subscribe, trial, etc.)
  • Instrument Amplitude (or equivalent product analytics) so growth can see funnels end-to-end
  • Integrate payment APIs — Stripe, Adyen, NMI (and similar) — checkout, webhooks, subscription status, refunds as needed
  • Work with PMM / UA / product on event naming, debug broken tracking, harden what “vibe code” left fragile

 

Must-have

  • Strong backend + enough front-end to ship funnel/product pages and tracking scripts
  • Real experience putting apps on self-hosted / VPS / container infra (not only managed toy deploys)
  • Hands-on GTM + GA4 (and pixel) event wiring you can walk through
  • Amplitude (or very similar product analytics) in production
  • At least one of Stripe / Adyen / NMI (others welcome) — comfortable reading API docs + webhooks
  • English enough to read technical docs and async with the team

 

Nice-to-have

  • Quiz / long-form web funnel or subscription paywall products
  • PSP aggregators (Solidgate, Apigate, etc.)
  • CAPI / server-side events; Meta signal quality hygiene
  • Node / Python / PHP / Next — whatever ships; stack is secondary to shipping production

 

Not a fit

  • Pure front-end / design-only
  • Never owned hosting or production deploys
  • “I’ll learn payments later” with no API/webhook history
  • Looking only for a slow enterprise FT ramp with no hourly start

 

How we hire

This is a full-time seat, but we start immediately on hourly until we’ve shipped enough together to convert to FT.

 

How to apply

In your application (or first message), list exactly what you can already do from what we need — short yes/no or 1-line proof for each:

  1. Take a vibe-coded / AI-built app (GitHub export / Base44-style) and move it to self-hosted infra
  2. Own hosting / deploys / env / secrets for a live web product
  3. Wire Meta/Google pixels
  4. Implement correct events in GTM + GA4 (purchase / subscribe / trial / etc.)
  5. Set up or run Amplitude (or equivalent) on a product funnel
  6. Integrate payments via API docs — which of Stripe / Adyen / NMI (or similar) you’ve done, including webhooks / subscriptions if any
  7. Hourly availability to start now + when you could go full-time

Optional plus: quiz / long web-funnel or subscription paywall experience (not required).

item.title: Node.js Backend Engineer (EHR Data Migration)
item.description:
SCIMUS is a software development outsourcing company with 10+ years of experience, helping businesses scale their engineering capacity across industries such as Healthcare, eCommerce, AdTech, and more. We're proud of our delivery track record: 95% of projects delivered on time, a 92% Net Promoter Score, and 9 out of 10 clients returning for repeat work.

We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer to join a healthcare data migration project. You will extract, transform, and migrate patient and practice data from a wide range of Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems into a unified platform. 

About You

  • Resourceful and relentless problem-solver - when the easy path fails, you find another;
  • Meticulous attention to detail, especially where sensitive data is concerned;
  • Align with key ethical principles, consistently demonstrating responsibility, confidentiality, and integrity;
  • Able to deliver under deadline pressure without cutting corners on quality.

Requirements

  • Strong programming skills, with hands-on experience in Node.js / JavaScript (ES Modules);
  • Confident, strong Linux user: command line, shell scripting (grep, sed, awk, find), ssh, permissions, and cron/scheduled tasks;
  • Proven experience with web scraping, API integration, and/or RPA, and the ability to pick the right data-acquisition approach per system: public APIs, unofficial/internal APIs, browser automation, HTML parsing, file exports, or RPA;
  • Solid experience with the core stack: MongoDB, axios, puppeteer, cheerio, and cookie/session handling (tough-cookie / http-cookie-agent);
  • Comfort parsing and normalizing many data formats - JSON, CSV, XML, HL7, CCDA, PDF, XLSX, and Access databases (csv-parse, fast-xml-parser, xlsx, mdb-reader, pdf-parse, officeparser, simple-hl7);
  • Schema definition and data validation with zod;
  • Familiarity with git, eslint + prettier, vitest, and Docker/docker compose;
  • Careful, secure handling of sensitive patient data - least privilege, and data protected in transit and at rest;
  • A track record of delivering on tight migration deadlines without compromising data accuracy.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with EHR / healthcare data systems;
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy regulations;
  • Experience reverse-engineering undocumented APIs;
  • Experience with additional headless-browser frameworks (e.g., Playwright).

As a Data Migration Engineer, You Will

  • Design and build data extraction pipelines from EHR systems, using whatever approach the source system demands;
  • Map and transform heterogeneous source data into standardized schemas;
  • Own the end-to-end migration for assigned practices, from raw export to validated import;
  • Write tests and validation checks to guarantee data completeness and accuracy;
  • Take ownership of your migration timeline, anticipate blockers early, and deliver on schedule;
  • Handle all patient data with care, confidentiality, and integrity, following the principle of least privilege;
  • Collaborate with the team to continuously improve extraction, mapping, and tooling.

What We Offer

  • You can fully realize your potential in a supportive environment where your experience is valued.
  • We believe in continuous learning and development - you'll have access to a library, weekly tech talks, and course compensation (including English classes);
  • If you love sharing knowledge, we'll fully support you!
  • 20 days of Paid Time Off;
  • A friendly, open atmosphere free from unnecessary bureaucracy, with a team that has a great sense of humor, where creativity and initiative are encouraged.
  • Regular team events, including Friday pizza parties 🍕

More About SCIMUS

🔗 Company site: https://thescimus.com 
🔗 Company profile on DOU: https://jobs.dou.ua/companies/scimus-solution/

🚀 If you want to grow, contribute, and work in a friendly, creative, and ambitious team, we'd love to hear from you!

item.title: Middle Node.js Developer
item.description:
What should you know about SKELAR? It's a venture builder — in other words, a company that builds companies. Together with founders, we create consumer businesses that become leaders in global markets across EdTech, Mental Health, Petcare, FashionTech, and beyond.

Our teams build tech products that win recognition from Product Hunt and The Webby Awards, earn thousands of glowing Trustpilot reviews, and reach over 10 million users worldwide. That kind of impact doesn't happen by accident — it starts with exceptional people, and our people are our top priority.

We've built an environment where expertise meets opportunity, and where there's no ceiling on what you can achieve. Now we're looking for the kind of people who don't just want a job — they want a challenge.

We’re looking for a Middle Node.js Developer for our partner company, Duomo.

Duomo is an app rooted in Christian values, helping people turn Scripture into daily habits and inner peace. We’re building a leading Christian-tech product for people seeking spiritual renewal.

 

You will be responsible for:
 

  • Driving MarTech Automation: Designing, developing, and scaling backend services to automate marketing technology processes and integration workflows.
  • Streamlining Creative Processes: Building robust tools and systems that automate the asset lifecycle and streamline creative operations for the team.
  • Enhancing System Observability: Implementing comprehensive tracking, metrics, logs, and tracing (Observability) to ensure high system visibility and performance monitoring.
  • Strengthening Infrastructure Reliability: Expanding test coverage (unit, integration, end-to-end) and setting up automated testing pipelines to ensure high code quality and fault tolerance.
  • Architecting Scalable Solutions: Participating in system architecture design, code reviews, and optimizing backend performance to support business growth.

 

What you need to succeed in this role:

 

  • 2+ years of experience with Node.js + TypeScript & NestJS.
  • PostgreSQL + any typed ORM (Drizzle, Prisma, or TypeORM).
  • Redis & Message Queues (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS) — hands-on experience with idempotency, retries, and distributed locks.
  • Third-party REST API integrations — handling rate limits, pagination, and partial failures.

  • Docker, CI/CD, and unit testing with Jest

     

    Nice-to-Have Requirements

  • Experience with Facebook Marketing API, Google Ads API, or other ad platforms (TikTok, Applovin)
  • Cloud & Infra: AWS (ECS, ECR, S3, Lambda) and GitHub Actions
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, and structured logging
  • Integrations with Airtable API and Google Sheets API
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) — structured output and prompt versioning

 

Why Duomo:

— You’ll work on a product with a clear mission and real values.
— You’ll help us transition from a content-rich app into a truly connected spiritual platform.
— You’ll be early enough to influence how product is done at Duomo long-term.

 

What we offer:

— Competitive salary;
— Significant impact on a rapidly growing business and contribution to how it shapes up;
— Ample career opportunities for ambitious growth and development;
— A possibility to attend internal, external courses, seminars and the access to a corporate library;
— Comfortable working environment. We provide all necessary work equipment for your role and serve complimentary breakfasts, lunches, and snacks in the office;
— 20 days of paid vacation, medical insurance and a variety of sports activities available for employees inside and outside the office.

 

At SKELAR, we've built an environment where people can grow, build, and do the most meaningful work of their careers:

  • SKELAR Platform. The operational backbone of our venture builder. It exists to help founders move faster and easier — so business teams can stay laser-focused on the product while 10+ specialized Platform takes care of everything else: Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT, and more.
  • Networking and knowledge-sharing as a way of life. Our people include co-founders who've launched multiple businesses and some of the sharpest specialists in the industry. Whatever expertise you need, it's never far away.
  • Learning programs you won't find anywhere else. We've developed our own educational tracks for teammates to choose from — a two-month school for first-time managers, intensive AI workshops, and professional clubs for engineers, product managers, and more.
  • Meaningful impact in Ukraine. The SKELAR Foundation was created by our own people, and every employee plays a part in bringing important social initiatives to life. We founded Europe's first accelerator for veterans and are working to build lasting support structures for veterans at a national scale.
  • Spaces designed to inspire. Our offices are places people actually want to be — with an in-house gym, a climbing wall, Bali-inspired green spaces, and libraries. Every detail, from service and security to comfort and design, is built to match the pace of our growing teams.
  • Everyday comfort built in. Meals, gym access in Kyiv or a partial fitness stipend in Warsaw, health insurance, paid business travel where the role requires it, and corporate partner discounts.


We'd love to tell you more in person.

Join us at SKELAR and help build the next big everything!
